name: Bangkok/ Suvarnabhumi International Airport

runway.v: three runways; the two longest, 01/19 and 02L/20R, are each 4,000 m long and 60 m wide

handling.v: ground handling by WFS Bangkok Air Ground Handling (BFS Ground) and Thai Airways International; no business aviation terminal is named in the AIP
handling.quote: Worldwide Flight Services Bangkok Air Ground Handling Co., Ltd. (BFS Ground); Thai Airways International Public Co.Ltd. (TG)

slots.v: Level 3 (coordinated) airport: slots are coordinated by CAAT and non-scheduled flights must obtain a slot (business aviation applies with a General Aviation Clearance Request, GCR); for Winter 2026/27 CAAT's capacity notice says private operations will not be accommodated at BKK (use DMK)
slots.quote: L3 | BKK/VTBS | Coordination | CAAT; Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

season_w26.v: Winter 2026/27 (25 Oct 2026 - 27 Mar 2027): CAAT capacity notice says private operations cannot be accommodated at BKK; aircraft ground time must not exceed 12 hours for scheduled and non-scheduled carriers
season_w26.quote: 2) PRIVATE OPERATIONS WILL NOT BE ABLE TO BE ACCOMMODATED. ... AIRCRAFT GROUND TIME MUST NOT EXCEED 12 HOURS FOR BOTH SCHEDULED AND NON-SCHEDULED CARRIERS OPERATING AT BKK.

permits.v: non-scheduled flights (including private flights) need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead through the online system (FPOS)
permits.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance
